six_bar.independent_contract: The profile specification requires this exact effective kit and firing profile hooks. The assertion is not inferred merely from a generated config.

six_bar.independent_oracle: Expected names come from separately created profile/repo inputs; forbidden names come from independent Global filesystem entries; hook evidence is a file written by the real CLI, not a mocked callback or production-derived expectation.
six_bar.stable_seam: createGrokAdapter.startSession drives the real installed CLI. The observed available_commands_update is provider protocol exposed through the AdapterContext raw-log boundary, and the hook marker is a filesystem effect.
six_bar.refactor_resistance: No private call order, source spelling, class tree, or internal helper shape is asserted. Internal preparation and adapter restructuring preserve catalog names and hook execution.
six_bar.unique_protection: The two inspect cases in this file and profile-launch.test.ts verify discovery/config/spawn setup, but inspect can misreport plugin state and never proves session-time plugin hook execution. No fake-provider test can prove real CLI loading. This session is therefore the narrowest real-provider owner of the runtime catalog/hook contract.
